correctness.rationale: The source treats real nonnegative p×q arrays (p,q>=2) of total mass 1 satisfying the adjacent Monge (submodular) inequality, explicitly excluding transportation polytopes and inverse Monge. For p<=q, source vertex/facet classification (Erickson–Kretschmann Proposition 5.1, Theorem 5.3) gives all coordinate and adjacent-cut facets; corner-rectangle normalized vertices maximize each cut slack at 1/w_ij with w_ij=min(i(q-j),(p-i)j). The proposed unnormalized Y=J/p+sum_{cuts}V_ij has total mass T=q+(p-1)(q-1)=p(q-1)+1 and exactly max cut slack at each cut. For a coordinate requiring a larger bound than 1/p, the rectangle at a corresponding cut appears with appropriate full or half coefficient; the tie argument uses r(p-r)>=p-1 and area >=p/2 to show J/p plus the half term suffices. Thus Y/T meets each primal facet reflection bound with h=T-1. Dual grid coefficients lambda_rs=1+w_rs-w_r,s-1-w_r-1,s+w_r-1,s-1 are >=0, because w_ij=i(q-j)-(iq-pj)_+ and the rectangular mixed second difference of the positive part is nonpositive. The exact mass decomposition ΣZ=Σlambda Z+Σ w_ij h_ij(Z) makes any center satisfy h+1>=q+(p-1)(q-1); transpose yields s=min(p,q)(max(p,q)-1). Independently reconstructed exact-rational primal center values, all coordinates and cut slacks, and dual positivity for all p=2..5 and p<=q<=6, beyond merely trusting the supplied verifier. This finite test is supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The normalized Monge cost-matrix polytope is a mathematically natural convex body arising from transportation/assignment inequalities; its exact Minkowski asymmetry is a separate affine invariant from its already-studied volume and face lattice. The result solves an unrestricted two-integer-parameter classification, supplies an explicit optimal center and a nonnegative dual mass-slack identity, and quantifies the exact defect from the simplex bound. The cut-area formulas and tied-cut constraints give substantive geometric content beyond a routine determinant computation.
residual_risks: Mathematical-value assessment is independent of code or novelty search; no broader unproved claim about all center sets is credited.

limitations: Nonnegative normalized Monge convention, p,q>=2; not inverse Monge or transportation polytope.
